72:14.text: (who have submitted to Allâh, after listening to this Qur’ân)
, and of us some are Al-Qâsitûn
(disbelievers - those who have deviated from the Right Path)
(i.e. has become a Muslim by submitting to Allâh)
, then such have sought the Right Path."

72:15.text: (disbelievers who deviated from the Right Path)
, they shall be firewood for Hell,

72:16.text: had believed in Allâh, and went on the Right Way
We would surely have bestowed on them water

72:17.text: That We might try them thereby. And whosoever turns away from the Reminder of his Lord
(i.e. this Qur’ân, - and practise not its laws and orders)
, He will cause him to enter in a severe torment

72:18.text: And the mosques are for Allâh
: so invoke not anyone along with Allâh.

72:19.text: And when the slave of Allâh
just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other
(in order to listen to the Prophet’s recitation)

72:20.text: , and I associate none as partners along with Him."

72:21.text: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the Right Path."

72:22.text: : "None can protect me from Allâh’s punishment
, nor can I find refuge except in Him.

72:23.text: , and whosoever disobeys Allâh and His Messenger, then Verily, for him is the Fire of Hell, he shall dwell therein forever."

72:24.text: Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning numbers.

72:25.text: which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.

72:26.text: , and He reveals to none His Ghaib

72:27.text: (He informs him of unseen as much as He likes)
, and then He makes a band of watching guards
to march before him and behind him.

72:28.text: have conveyed the Messages of their Lord
surrounds all that which is with them, and He
(i.e. He knows the exact number of everything)
